name: Flare-ON SS
description: The standard Flare-ON: Sundancer Compact fusion, a light laser, and modest cargo. The configuration most pilots mean when they say "Flare".

name: Flare-ON SK
description: The resort-world SK trim: gravitic Loft drive, turbo laser, and premium cabin kit. Marketed as a toy, flown like a hot rod where local gravity is strong.

name: Pegasus P101
description: The everyday Pegasus: GI hydro-thermal drive, spartan four-berth life support, cargo bay, and a mass driver for defence. Still the galaxy's default private ship.

name: Pegasus P103
description: The luxury Pegasus trim: same hydro-thermal backbone as the P101, but a two-berth VitaCore cabin and no nose gun. Comfort over firepower.

name: Pegasus P103a
description: GVW's late antimatter hot rod: Ionique Annihilon drive, plasma cannon, and law-enforcement sensors. Rare in civilian hands; common on patrol lots.

name: Krypton K2
description: The workhorse K2: Bellatrix hydro-thermal, basic laser, and a ten-tonne cargo bay. Underpowered on paper, ubiquitous in practice.

name: Krypton K3
description: The performance Krypton: Bellatrix Trace antimatter and a lighter cargo fit. For pilots who outgrew the K2's leisurely acceleration.

name: Wolff Warrior
description: Gunship conversion of the Wolff freighter: antimatter drive, missile and scatter mounts, no cargo bay. Built to win fights, not haul crates.

name: Wolff Gladius
description: A modernised Wolff gunship: Privy Seal Null antimatter, deflector shield, and heavier plate than the Warrior. Placeholder yard spec where lore is thin.

name: Dragon Gold
description: The production Dragon interceptor: Bellatrix Trace antimatter, alpha hyperdrive, laser and plasma burst. Kolmogorov-Smirnov's tactical fighter in showroom trim.

name: Juno 1045
description: Budget Juno scout: Tukey burner and HandyAir pack, small cargo, light laser. A cheap first ship for hub traffic.

name: Juno 1088
description: Mid trim Juno with Rhumb hydro-thermal and Circinus sensors. Channel-hop courier fit with a little more range than the 1045.

name: Juno 1090
description: Long-hop Juno: electric-plasma Rhumb drive, channel cabin, mass driver. Heavier electronics and a defensive punch for stubborn routes.

name: Silhouette Mk8
description: The common Silhouette fighter fit: Drawbar chemical punch, turbo and mass-driver pair, light plate. Combine yard standard for orbital defence contracts.

name: Mantis XF900
description: Legacy Mantis series, out of production: Slipstream hydro-thermal, single Aegis seat, one light laser, small fuel. Still turns up on used lots and in reserve squadrons.

name: Mantis XF4400
description: Current mid-tier Mantis: Privy Seal F-11 fusion, light and medium lasers, Praetorium avionics. Faster and meaner than the retired XF900, still sensible on fuel.

name: Mantis XF5700
description: Top-line Mantis interceptor: Privy Seal Null antimatter, turbo laser and plasma burst, no armour plate. Glass cannon for pilots who trust speed over chitanium.
